summary: Neiva’s municipal cadastral directorate and gestor-catastral status are first-party evidenced, and IGAC’s public Dato Fundamental Catastro service exposes U_TERRENO/R_TERRENO polygon schemas with CODIGO as a candidate native identity. Exact-point and municipality-filter geometry requests did not yield a safe usable parcel response, so no sample was retained.
queryOutcomes: English and Spanish first-party discovery queries, exact text, outcomes and actual URLs are recorded in city-2797-neiva.json.
requestOutcomes: Municipal pages and IGAC service/layer metadata returned successfully. The exact WUP point query timed out; a municipality-code filter was blocked by an upstream WAF; the viewer shell also timed out. No credentials, CAPTCHA bypass, private token, unsafe field request or TLS exception was used.
scopeLimits: Local municipal custodianship is evidenced, but complete Neiva city coverage was not established.
The exact-point timeout was not treated as a hit or miss and does not support an absence claim.

IGAC service metadata and general cadastral descriptions do not prove that every municipal feature is anonymously queryable or complete.

nativeIdentityPolicy: CODIGO was documented as the official U_TERRENO/R_TERRENO schema’s candidate native cadastral identity; no feature-level identity was retained because no verified Neiva feature response was obtained.
